resources.string: Set your personal GIPHY API key for GIF and sticker search

Your key is stored encrypted on this device and excluded from settings backups. New search text is sent to GIPHY only when you press Search. Loading more results uses that submitted search. One personal key is used for GIFs and stickers.
Unlock your device to access the GIPHY key.
Secure key storage is unavailable. The key could not be read or saved. No unencrypted copy will be used.
